projects.title: Sushi Guy
projects.description: Sushi Guy is a frontend website concept for a private chef and catering service. It features a clean, user-friendly booking experience where customers can explore culinary services, choose an experience, provide their event details, and proceed through a prepayment flow. The project focuses on the website’s design, layout, responsiveness, and overall user experience.

projects.title: CabangRun
projects.description: CabangRun is a frontend website concept for a local running club, designed to showcase the club’s past races, upcoming events, activities, and achievements. The website provides a central space for runners and visitors to explore the club’s events, learn more about its activities, and stay connected with the local running community.

projects.title: Bomb Taco
projects.description: Designed and developed a modern, responsive website for Bomb Taco, focusing on a bold visual identity that reflects the brand’s energetic personality. I handled both the UI/UX design and full website development, ensuring a seamless, engaging, and user-friendly experience.

projects.title: Big Island Cleaners
projects.description: Implemented the provided website design using WordPress, translating the approved design into a responsive and functional website. I handled the WordPress development and ensured the site accurately reflected the intended layout, content, and user experience.

projects.title: Broken Wrench Repair, LLC
projects.description: Developed a professional and responsive website for an automotive service business. I handled the website development, implementing the design and content to create a user-friendly experience that showcases their automotive maintenance, cleaning, and repair services.
